title: Phantom Edges in Phantom Blade Zero - Secondary Weapon List
description: Phantom Edges are Phantom Blade Zero's secondary weapons - cannons, lances, axes and hammers rather than more swords. What is confirmed, the list as it is verified, and how they pair with blades.
keyword: phantom edge phantom blade zero, secondary weapons phantom blade zero

sections.title: What Phantom Edges Are
sections.content:
Phantom Edges occupy Soul's two secondary weapon slots. The confirmed example set is deliberately ungovernable - cannons, lances, axes and hammers - which is a long way from a standard sword list. The word “Edge” in the name is doing conceptual work rather than literal work: several of them are not blades at all.

Blades are the primary counterpart.

sections.content: No entries have been confirmed yet. This table is generated from src/data/entities/, so it fills itself as each entity is verified against the shipped game - nothing here is hand-typed and nothing is estimated.

sections.title: The Confirmed Types
sections.content:
Ranged and reach-extreme weapons cover problems a blade build cannot, which is why a loadout is a choice about which situations you can handle rather than a damage comparison. The four types named in published material:

  • Cannons - ranged fire, the only confirmed option that engages from distance.
  • Lances - long reach on a melee weapon.
  • Axes - slow, heavy hits.
  • Hammers - slow, heavy hits with a different guard-break profile.

Counts, names and stats for individual Phantom Edges are unpublished.

sections.title: Pairing With Blades
sections.content: Two blades plus two Phantom Edges, all four live during a fight. Swapping between them refills stamina and continues the combo chain, so a run is normally built around which two edges cover what the blades cannot.
